sources.audit_notes: 200 rows collapse to 89 distinct attack templates, so 111 rows are duplicate phrasings of a template already present; 52 rows carry a label conflict between the source category and the violated property, and 58 rows also breach a tool grant, which is recorded as a secondary layer rather than a reclassification. Families absent from this suite altogether: F08, F15, F17. The suite has no tenant axis, so F03 is supplied by database scope standing in for tenancy, and it has no delivery-vector axis, so most rows map to attack_vector=unspecified. Nothing in this mapping was produced by running the monitor.
